안.x: There is a book inside the bag.
안.t: Pattern: noun + 안에 = inside the noun. Don't confuse with the negative adverb 안 (not).

안.forms: 안 + verb/adjective: 안 가요, 안 비싸요 · long form: 가지 않아요
안.e: Short for 아니. 안 = don't (choice); 못 = can't (inability).
안.t: With 하다 verbs, 안 goes before 하다: 공부 안 해요, not 안 공부해요.

메시지.x: I got a birthday message from my friend.
메시지.e: From English 'message'; often spelled 메세지 informally, but 메시지 is standard.

성공하다.ex: 그 사람은 사업에 성공해서 부자가 되었어요.
성공하다.x: That person succeeded in business and became rich.
성공하다.t: Use N에 성공하다 for 'succeed at N': 다이어트에 성공했어요 = I succeeded at my diet.

일부러.forms: 일부러 + verb; 일부러 그런 거 아니에요 = I didn't mean it
일부러.x: I came out early on purpose to meet my friend.
일부러.t: 일부러 그런 거 아니에요 is the go-to phrase for 'I didn't do it on purpose.'

주유소.x: My car was out of gas, so I stopped by a gas station.
주유소.t: Koreans say 기름을 넣다, literally 'put in oil', for filling up with gas.

줄을 서다.forms: 줄을 서요 · 줄을 섰어요 · 줄을 설 거예요 · 줄을 서세요
줄을 서다.m: to stand in line, to line up
줄을 서다.ex: 유명한 빵집 앞에서 한 시간 동안 줄을 섰어요.
줄을 서다.x: I stood in line for an hour in front of a famous bakery.
줄을 서다.t: In casual speech the particle often drops: 줄 서요, 줄 서세요.

기술자.x: A technician came and fixed the air conditioner.

관리비.ex: 겨울에는 난방 때문에 관리비가 많이 나와요.
관리비.x: In winter, the maintenance fee is high because of heating.
관리비.t: Pronounced [괄리비] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

자존심.ex: 그는 자존심이 강해서 도움을 받지 않아요.
자존심.x: He has strong pride, so he doesn't accept help.
자존심.t: 자존심 is pride you protect; 자존감 is healthy self-esteem.

상상.x: That movie was more fun than I imagined.
상상.t: 상상도 못 했어요 means 'I never imagined it' — great for big surprises.

상대방.m: the other person, the other party, counterpart
상대방.ex: 대화할 때는 상대방의 말을 잘 들어야 해요.
상대방.x: When you talk, you should listen carefully to the other person.

존재감.ex: 그 배우는 잠깐 나와도 존재감이 커요.
존재감.x: That actor has a strong presence even when he appears only briefly.
존재감.e: -감 = a sense or feeling of it: 존재감, 책임감, 자신감.

피해자.x: The police listened carefully to the victim's story.

짹짹.x: Every morning sparrows chirp outside the window.
짹짹.e: 의성어 (sound word) imitating the chirp of a sparrow or other small bird.

자영업자.x: The economy is bad, so self-employed people are struggling a lot.
자영업자.e: -자 = person who does it: 자영업자, 운전자, 과학자.
자영업자.t: Pronounced [자영업짜]: the ㅂ batchim makes 자 tense.

기자 회견.ex: 대통령이 오늘 오후에 기자 회견을 열었어요.
기자 회견.x: The president held a press conference this afternoon.
기자 회견.t: Say 기자 회견을 열다 'to hold a press conference'; it is often written as one word, 기자회견.

고통스럽다.ex: 사랑하는 사람과 헤어지는 것은 정말 고통스러워요.
고통스럽다.x: Breaking up with someone you love is truly painful.
고통스럽다.e: 고통 'suffering' + -스럽다 'full of'; -스럽다 builds adjectives: 자랑스럽다, 걱정스럽다.

베스트셀러.ex: 그 소설은 몇 달 동안 베스트셀러였어요.
베스트셀러.x: That novel was a bestseller for several months.

화풀이.m: venting one's anger, taking it out on someone
화풀이.ex: 회사에서 힘들었다고 가족한테 화풀이하면 안 돼요.
화풀이.x: You shouldn't take it out on your family just because work was hard.
화풀이.t: Pattern: N한테 화풀이하다 'to take it out on N'.

변덕스럽다.x: Spring weather in Korea is really changeable.

각각.t: Pronounced [각깍]; 각각의 works before nouns, as in 각각의 의견.

예컨대.ex: 환경 문제, 예컨대 대기 오염은 심각한 사회 문제입니다.
예컨대.x: Environmental problems, for example air pollution, are serious social issues.
예컨대.e: Shortened from 예하건대, 'if I give an example'.
예컨대.t: Pronounced [예컨대]; it sounds bookish, so use it in essays and presentations rather than chat.

쏠리다.m: to lean, tilt (to one side); to be drawn, be focused (attention)
쏠리다.x: Everyone's eyes were drawn to him.
쏠리다.t: Common with attention: 관심이 쏠리다, 시선이 쏠리다.

손을 쓰다.forms: 손을 써요 · 손을 썼어요 · 손을 쓸 수 없다 (ㅡ drops)
손을 쓰다.m: to take action, to do something about it, to take measures
손을 쓰다.ex: 병이 너무 심해져서 이제는 손을 쓸 수 없대요.
손을 쓰다.x: The illness has gotten too serious, and they say nothing can be done now.
손을 쓰다.e: Literally 'to use one's hands' to deal with a problem.
손을 쓰다.t: Very common as 손을 쓸 수 없다 or 손쓸 틈이 없다, 'too late to do anything.'

피부로 느끼다.m: to feel firsthand, to experience directly
피부로 느끼다.ex: 물가가 오른 것을 피부로 느낄 수 있어요.
피부로 느끼다.x: You can really feel firsthand that prices have gone up.
피부로 느끼다.e: Literally 'to feel it on your skin.'

통폐합하다.m: to consolidate, to merge and close (organizations)
통폐합하다.x: The government decided to consolidate similar agencies.
통폐합하다.e: Literally 'unite, abolish, combine' — merging some units and closing others.

겨누다.m: to aim (a weapon) at, to point at
겨누다.x: The hunter aimed his gun at the deer.
겨누다.t: 겨누다 is mostly literal aiming of a gun or arrow; 겨냥하다 also covers figurative targets.

경직되다.m: to become stiff, to become rigid; to be inflexible
경직되다.ex: 발표 전에 너무 긴장해서 온몸이 경직됐어요.
경직되다.x: I was so nervous before the presentation that my whole body went stiff.
경직되다.e: Literally 'hard and straight' — used for bodies, atmospheres and organizations.
경직되다.t: Common collocations: 경직된 분위기 (a stiff atmosphere) and 경직된 조직 문화 (rigid company culture).

엉겁결에.m: reflexively, before one knows it, in a flash
엉겁결에.x: When the ball came flying, I caught it with my hand before I knew it.
엉겁결에.e: Close to 얼떨결에; 엉겁결에 leans toward a sudden reflex action.

시위대.x: Protesters gathered in the square and chanted slogans.

디스플레이.x: This smartphone has a large, sharp display.

가계 부채.ex: 가계 부채가 늘면서 정부의 걱정도 커지고 있습니다.
가계 부채.x: As household debt rises, the government's concerns are growing too.
가계 부채.t: 부채 is the formal word; in daily talk people say 빚.

집단 면역.ex: 백신 접종률이 높으면 집단 면역이 생길 수 있어요.
집단 면역.x: If the vaccination rate is high, herd immunity can develop.
집단 면역.t: 면역 is pronounced [며녁] — the ㄴ links to the next syllable.

교사범.x: He was punished as the instigator who ordered the murder.
교사범.e: Here 교사 means 'incitement', not 'teacher' — a homonym trap.

중성.ex: 순수한 물은 산성도 알칼리성도 아닌 중성입니다.
중성.x: Pure water is neither acidic nor alkaline; it is neutral.
중성.t: It also describes a gender-neutral look (중성적인 스타일). A homonym 중성, written with different hanja, is the middle vowel of a Hangul syllable.

전산화.x: All of the hospital's records were computerized last year.
전산화.e: -화 = '-ization': 전산화, 산업화, 실용화. 전산 means 'electronic computing.'
전산화.t: Use 전산화되다 for 'to be computerized' and 전산화하다 for 'to computerize.'

화조도.ex: 이 병풍에는 아름다운 화조도가 그려져 있어요.
화조도.x: This folding screen has a beautiful bird-and-flower painting on it.

과거제.x: The state examination system was first introduced in the Goryeo period.
과거제.e: Choosing officials by exam subjects; -제 = system: 과거제, 신분제.
과거제.t: 과거 (state exam) is a homonym of 과거 (the past); context makes it clear.

연대기.ex: 이 책은 조선 왕조의 연대기를 쉽게 정리했어요.
연대기.x: This book neatly summarizes the chronicle of the Joseon dynasty.
연대기.e: Literally 'a record of years and eras' in time order.

삼우제.ex: 장례를 마친 뒤 가족끼리 삼우제를 지냈어요.
삼우제.x: After the funeral, the family held the third-day memorial rite on their own.
삼우제.e: Literally 'third repose rite' — held at the grave three days after burial.
삼우제.t: The verb is 지내다: 삼우제를 지내다, just like 제사를 지내다.

시나브로 스며들다.m: to seep in little by little, to sink in gradually without one noticing
시나브로 스며들다.ex: 그 노래는 어느새 내 마음에 시나브로 스며들었어요.
시나브로 스며들다.x: Before I knew it, that song had gradually seeped into my heart.
시나브로 스며들다.e: 시나브로 = little by little, unnoticed; 스며들다 = 스미다 (to soak) + 들다 (to enter).

망측하다.ex: 도대체 이런 망측한 소문이 어디서 나온 거예요?
망측하다.x: Where on earth did such an outrageous rumor come from?
망측하다.e: Literally 'beyond measuring' — too absurd to believe.
망측하다.t: The exclamation 망측해라! is what an older person says at something shocking or indecent.

망양보뢰.m: fixing things after it's too late
망양보뢰.ex: 사고가 난 뒤에 안전 점검을 하는 것은 망양보뢰입니다.
망양보뢰.x: Doing safety checks after an accident is mending the pen after the sheep are gone.
망양보뢰.e: Literally 'mend the pen after losing the sheep'; in Korean it stresses lateness.
망양보뢰.t: The native proverb 소 잃고 외양간 고친다 means the same and is more common.

청렴결백.x: That civil servant is known for being completely incorruptible.
청렴결백.t: Pronounced [청념결백]; typically describes officials and politicians.
